reasons.plausibility: Introducing Pt to induce an L10 phase and thereby increase magnetocrystalline anisotropy is consistent with known effects in Fe–Pt systems, although achieving the proposed high Pt fraction and desired short-range ordering in a multicomponent HEA may need experimental confirmation.
reasons.testability: It can be tested directly by synthesizing the Pt-substituted material, verifying the L10 phase via XRD/TEM, and measuring its coercive field via magnetometry.
reasons.usefulness: It provides a clear, actionable strategy for enhancing coercivity via a well-defined mechanism and an unambiguous experimental design that would interest researchers in magnetic HEAs.
